            "feverishness, tiredness, muscle aches or body cramps, night-time chest discomfort. Prefer allergy "
            "over common cold when the symptoms are chronic, recurrent, come at night, or when systemic aches, "
            "fatigue and 'feverish' feelings accompany nasal/throat symptoms without productive coloured phlegm.\n"
            "- common cold: an acute short-lived infection — runny nose with sneezing, throat irritation, cough "
            "with phlegm, sinus pressure, congestion, mild headache, chest pain from coughing, malaise.\n"
            "- bronchial asthma: breathlessness / difficulty breathing or wheezing is the central complaint, with "
            "cough, mucoid sputum, fatigue and sometimes fever. Choose asthma over pneumonia when the emphasis is "

            "vomiting.\n"
            "- gastroesophageal reflux disease: heartburn/burning in chest, acid regurgitation, sour taste, "
            "cough or worse symptoms after meals or lying down, ulcers on tongue.\n"
            "- peptic ulcer disease: gnawing upper-abdominal/stomach pain relieved or triggered by eating, "
            "indigestion, belching, vomiting, passing dark stools, abdominal bloating.\n"
            "- urinary tract infection: burning or urgent urination, foul-smelling or bloody urine, bladder "
            "discomfort, fever.\n"
            "- varicose veins: bulging, swollen, twisted, visible leg veins, cramps, swelling, bruising or "
            "obesity-related leg discomfort.\n\n"
            "Procedure: list the discriminating symptoms mentioned, check them against the candidate diseases, "
            "eliminate candidates that require a hallmark symptom the patient never mentions, and pick the one "
            "whose hallmark features are actually present. You may choose a label outside the candidate list if "
            "it clearly fits better. Answer with exactly one label from the allowed set, lowercase, nothing else."
        )

            "symptoms: str -> candidates: list[str]",
            shortlist_instructions,
        ))
        self.decide = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str, candidates: list[str] -> disease: Literal[%s]" % labels,
            decide_instructions,
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import difflib

        allowed = [
            "allergy", "arthritis", "bronchial asthma", "cervical spondylosis", "chicken pox",
            "common cold", "dengue", "diabetes", "drug reaction", "fungal infection",
            "gastroesophageal reflux disease", "hypertension", "impetigo", "jaundice", "malaria",
            "migraine", "peptic ulcer disease", "pneumonia", "psoriasis", "typhoid",
            "urinary tract infection", "varicose veins",
        ]

        def normalize(value: str):
            """Map a free-form model answer onto one of the allowed disease labels, or None."""
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                return None
            text = value.strip().strip(".'\"").lower()
            text = " ".join(text.split())
            if text in allowed:
                return text
            for label in allowed:
                if label in text:
                    return label
            match = difflib.get_close_matches(text, allowed, n=1, cutoff=0.6)
            return match[0] if match else None

        symptoms = inputs.get("symptoms", "")

        candidates = []
        try:
            short = self.shortlist(symptoms=symptoms)
            raw = short.candidates
            if isinstance(raw, str):
                raw = [part for part in raw.replace("\n", ",").split(",")]
            for item in list(raw)[:6]:
                label = normalize(str(item))
                if label and label not in candidates:
                    candidates.append(label)
        except Exception:
            candidates = []

        if not candidates:
            candidates = list(allowed)

        disease = None
        try:
            decided = self.decide(symptoms=symptoms, candidates=candidates)
            disease = normalize(str(decided.disease))
        except Exception:
            disease = None

        if disease is None:
            disease = candidates[0] if candidates else allowed[0]

        return dspy.Prediction(disease=disease)

            "7. relation of symptoms to food, meals, lying down, medication, night-time, or season\n"
            "8. respiratory / nasal features (sneezing, runny or blocked nose, watery eyes, loss of taste or "
            "smell, cough, sputum colour, wheeze, breathlessness)\n"
            "9. digestive features (vomiting, nausea, loose stools, constipation, belching, regurgitation, "
            "sour taste, dark stools, abdominal bloating)\n"
            "10. other notable features (yellowing, weight loss, thirst, dizziness, visual disturbance, "
            "joint swelling, nail changes, leg vein changes, urinary burning, tiredness, loss of appetite)\n\n"
            "Be concise: each line at most one short phrase."
        )

        decide_instructions = (
            "You are diagnosing from a patient's free-text symptoms, an extracted feature checklist, and a list "
            "of deterministic keyword cues found in the text. Choose exactly ONE disease from the closed label "
            "set. Weigh the DISCRIMINATING features; fever, fatigue, headache and generic body ache by "
            "themselves discriminate nothing.\n\n"
            "SKIN COMPLAINTS — decide by lesion morphology, in this priority order:\n"
            "- psoriasis: the rash is FLAKY, scaly, peeling, silvery or dry, forms defined patches, keeps "
            "spreading to new areas (chest, belly, elbows, scalp), is itchy and/or painful, often worse at "
            "night; nail pitting/dents and joint pain may or may not be mentioned. Flaking or scaling skin is "
            "by itself enough to pick psoriasis over allergy or chicken pox.\n"
            "- impetigo: blisters or bumps that are FLUID-FILLED or PUS-FILLED, red and raised, PAINFUL/tender "
            "to touch, sometimes with yellow crusts or oozing, together with fever. Painful fluid-filled sores "
            "= impetigo, not chicken pox.\n"
            "- fungal infection: generalized itching all over the body with dischromic / differently-coloured "
            "scaly patches AND nodular eruptions or small pimple-like bumps; no fever, no nail pitting.\n"
            "- drug reaction: rash, itching, hives, stomach pain or vomiting that started after taking a "
            "medicine.\n"
            "- chicken pox: an ordinary red ITCHY rash (arms, neck, trunk) with the patient feeling generally "
            "unwell, uncomfortable, tired, loss of appetite, nausea, mild fever — but WITHOUT flaking/scaling, "
            "WITHOUT nodules, WITHOUT painful pus-filled crusted sores. This is the default answer for a plain "
            "itchy rash plus malaise.\n"
            "- NEVER answer 'allergy' for a complaint whose main problem is a skin rash. In this label set "
            "'allergy' is a respiratory/nasal condition (continuous sneezing, watery or itchy eyes, blocked or "
            "runny nose, loss of taste and smell, sore throat, chills, feverish feeling, tiredness, muscle "
            "aches, night-time chest tightness, recurrent or seasonal course).\n\n"
            "FEVER / SYSTEMIC ILLNESS:\n"
            "- dengue: PAIN BEHIND THE EYES (retro-orbital pain) with high fever, severe headache and body/bone "
            "ache is decisive — choose dengue whenever retro-orbital pain is mentioned with fever, even if "
            "chills are also present and even if no rash is described. Red spots/patches and low platelets "
            "reinforce it.\n"
            "- malaria: shaking chills AND heavy sweating with high (often cyclical) fever, vomiting, nausea, "
            "headache and muscle pain, WITHOUT pain behind the eyes.\n"
            "- typhoid: prolonged continuous fever with abdominal pain, constipation or diarrhoea, belly "
            "discomfort, toxic feeling; digestive complaints dominate.\n"
            "- pneumonia: high fever with chills, chest pain, rusty or blood-tinged sputum, fast breathing, "
            "sweating, malaise.\n"
            "- bronchial asthma: breathlessness / difficulty breathing, wheezing, dry or mucoid cough, "
            "weakness; breathing difficulty is the central complaint and there is no purulent sputum.\n"
            "- common cold: acute short illness with runny nose, sneezing, throat irritation, cough with "
            "phlegm, sinus pressure, congestion, mild headache.\n\n"
            "DIGESTIVE COMPLAINTS — decide by the LOCATION of the burning/pain:\n"
            "- peptic ulcer disease: burning, gnawing or aching pain located in the STOMACH or upper abdomen, "
            "triggered or worsened by eating (especially spicy or acidic food) or by hunger, with indigestion, "
            "belching, abdominal bloating, vomiting, loose or dark stools. Stomach-located burning means ulcer "
            "EVEN IF it is worse when lying down.\n"
            "- gastroesophageal reflux disease: burning in the CHEST (heartburn), acid or food coming back up, "
            "sour taste in the mouth, sore throat, bad breath, chest pressure or discomfort radiating to neck / "
            "jaw / arm, cough, ulcers on tongue.\n\n"
            "OTHER LABELS:\n"
            "- hypertension: dizziness, loss of balance, poor concentration, anxiety, occasional chest pain and "
            "headache, with no visual aura and no one-sided throbbing headache.\n"
            "- migraine: throbbing headache attacks with blurred or disturbed vision, light/sound sensitivity, "
            "nausea, irritability, acidity, stiff neck.\n"
            "- cervical spondylosis: neck, shoulder and upper-back pain or stiffness, dizziness with neck "
            "movement, weakness or tingling in the arms.\n"
            "- arthritis: joint pain, swelling, stiffness, difficulty walking or moving joints; no rash.\n"
            "- diabetes: excessive thirst and urination, increased hunger, weight loss, blurred vision, "
            "slow-healing wounds, tiredness.\n"
            "- jaundice: yellow skin and eyes, dark urine, itching, abdominal pain, weight loss, vomiting.\n"
            "- urinary tract infection: burning or urgent urination, foul-smelling or bloody urine, bladder "
            "discomfort.\n"
            "- varicose veins: bulging, twisted, swollen visible leg veins, leg cramps, swelling, bruising.\n\n"
            "Procedure: name the discriminating features present, discard every disease that requires a "
            "hallmark feature the patient never mentions, honour the deterministic cues supplied, then pick the "
            "single best fit. Answer with exactly one label from the allowed set, lowercase, nothing else."
        )

        self.extract = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str -> findings: str",
            extract_instructions,
        ))
        self.decide = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str, findings: str, cues: list[str] -> disease: Literal[%s]" % labels,
            decide_instructions,
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import difflib

        allowed = [
            "allergy", "arthritis", "bronchial asthma", "cervical spondylosis", "chicken pox",
            "common cold", "dengue", "diabetes", "drug reaction", "fungal infection",
            "gastroesophageal reflux disease", "hypertension", "impetigo", "jaundice", "malaria",
            "migraine", "peptic ulcer disease", "pneumonia", "psoriasis", "typhoid",
            "urinary tract infection", "varicose veins",
        ]

        def normalize(value) -> str:
            """Map a free-form model answer onto one of the allowed disease labels, or None."""
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                return None
            text = value.strip().strip(".'\"").lower()
            text = " ".join(text.split())
            if text in allowed:
                return text
            for label in allowed:
                if label in text:
                    return label
            match = difflib.get_close_matches(text, allowed, n=1, cutoff=0.6)
            return match[0] if match else None

        def build_cues(text: str) -> list:
            """Deterministic keyword cues that point at hallmark discriminating features."""
            t = " " + " ".join(text.lower().split()) + " "

            def has(*words):
                return any(w in t for w in words)

            cues = []
            if has("behind my eyes", "behind the eyes", "behind eyes", "retro-orbital", "eye pain with fever"):
                cues.append("retro-orbital (behind-the-eyes) pain reported -> hallmark of dengue")
            if has("flak", "scal", "peel", "silver", "dry patch", "flaking"):
                cues.append("flaky/scaly/peeling skin reported -> hallmark of psoriasis, rules out allergy")
            if has("nail", "pitting", "dent in my nail"):
                cues.append("nail changes reported -> supports psoriasis")
            if has("filled with fluid", "fluid-filled", "fluid filled", "blister", "pus", "crust", "oozing"):
                cues.append("fluid- or pus-filled blisters / crusting reported -> hallmark of impetigo")
            if has("painful to touch", "tender to touch", "sore to touch", "hurts to touch"):
                cues.append("lesions painful/tender to touch -> favors impetigo over chicken pox")
            if has("nodule", "nodular", "pimple", "small bumps", "bumps that look"):
                cues.append("nodular / pimple-like eruptions reported -> favors fungal infection")
            if has("chill") and has("sweat"):
                cues.append("shaking chills together with heavy sweating -> favors malaria")
            if has("stomach", "belly ache", "upper abdomen", "abdominal pain", "tummy"):
                if has("burn", "pain", "ache"):
                    cues.append("burning/pain located in the stomach or upper abdomen -> favors peptic ulcer disease")
            if has("heartburn", "acid reflux", "regurgit", "sour taste", "comes back up", "burning in my chest",
                   "burning in the chest"):
                cues.append("chest heartburn / acid regurgitation -> favors gastroesophageal reflux disease")
            if has("after eating", "after meals", "spicy", "acidic food"):
                cues.append("symptoms triggered by eating specific foods -> favors peptic ulcer disease")
            if has("rash", "skin", "itch"):
                cues.append("skin-dominant complaint -> 'allergy' is a nasal/respiratory label and must not be chosen")
            if has("sneez", "runny nose", "stuffy", "congest", "watery eyes", "loss of smell", "loss of taste"):
                cues.append("nasal/eye symptoms reported -> consider allergy vs common cold")
            if has("after taking", "started the medication", "new medicine", "new medication", "after i took"):
                cues.append("symptoms began after taking a medicine -> favors drug reaction")
            return cues

        symptoms = inputs.get("symptoms", "") or ""
        cues = build_cues(symptoms)

        findings = ""
        try:
            ext = self.extract(symptoms=symptoms)
            findings = str(getattr(ext, "findings", "") or "")
        except Exception:
            findings = ""

        disease = None
        try:
            decided = self.decide(symptoms=symptoms, findings=findings, cues=cues)
            disease = normalize(str(decided.disease))
        except Exception:
            disease = None

        # Guard: 'allergy' is a nasal/respiratory label; never allow it for a purely skin complaint.
        if disease == "allergy":
            low = symptoms.lower()
            skin_words = ("rash", "skin", "itch", "patch", "bump", "blister", "flak", "scal")
            nasal_words = ("sneez", "nose", "nasal", "congest", "watery eyes", "smell", "taste",
                           "throat", "cough", "breath", "wheez", "chest")
            if any(w in low for w in skin_words) and not any(w in low for w in nasal_words):
                if any("flak" in low or "scal" in low or "peel" in low for _ in [0]):
                    disease = "psoriasis"
                else:
                    disease = "chicken pox"

        if disease is None:
            disease = allowed[0]

        return dspy.Prediction(disease=str(disease))
